text: Jefferies raised its price target on Charles Schwab (SCHW) to $121 from $114 in a broader roundup of analyst rating and target price revisions across multiple sectors. The update also included notable moves in financial peers, with Jefferies raising targets on Morgan Stanley to $212 (from $186), LPL Financial to $426 (from $391), and Interactive Brokers to $83 (from $80), while cutting Raymond James to $166. Other highlights included Jefferies upgrading Brunswick to buy, JP Morgan initiating Parker-Hannifin at overweight, and RBC initiating Wealthfront at outperform, reflecting generally constructive sentiment toward brokerage and wealth management stocks entering the new year.
